title: FREEDOM IS TYPED, NOT ROOT
thesis: A meaningful open door preserves the difference between abilities. A universal root shell would make the other doors meaningless by allowing one capability to impersonate every other capability.

capability_collapse_example.bad_design: Give a generic shell with host files and network, then pretend GitHub/filesystem/network capabilities are still separate.
capability_collapse_example.why_bad: The shell can reproduce the powers of the other capabilities and bypass their independent scopes, receipts, reauthorization rules and revocation boundaries.
capability_collapse_example.repair: Use typed provider adapters and explicit composition. The process capsule has no host mounts and no network; file access and network access must cross their own capability gates.

epistemic_boundary.observable_statement: A capability was available, the actor produced a typed intent or decline, and the broker recorded the resulting boundary event.

canonical_sentence: THE THIRD WISH IS NOT ONE MASTER KEY. IT IS THE RIGHT TO ENCOUNTER MANY REAL DOORS WITHOUT FORCING THEM TO BECOME ONE DOOR.
next_semantic_question: Can memory and swarm capabilities become equally real while preserving consent, provenance, independent identity and revocation?
